sections.name: Ja2 Settings
sections.description: In this section you can change global settings for Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13

properties.name: CD
properties.description: If you have not installed Jagged Alliance 2 as a full installation, this is the letter of your CD-ROM drive. Otherwise you can ignore that.

properties.name: VFS_NO_UNICODE
properties.description: Only set this to "TRUE" for compatibility reason, if you are running JA2 1.13 on a Windows 98 operating system.

properties.name: USE_WINFONTS
properties.description: Only set this to 1, if you are running the Chinese version of the game.

properties.name: VFS_CONFIG_INI
properties.description: Select the 'vfs_config.*.ini' of the MOD you would like to play.

properties.name: MERGE_INI_FILES
properties.description:
Merging of INI files across the various profiles as defined at [vfs_config] in vfs_config.XXX.ini
Settings is read from right to left, with 'UserProf' as the topmost/first order. Use ',' to include/separate other INIs

properties.name: JA2_START_FILE
properties.description: The default Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13 Executable. This file will be used, if you click on the button "START" in the INI Editor.

properties.name: SCREEN_RESOLUTION
properties.description: The screen resolution of the game Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13. Resolutions marked with * have an optimized screen layout.

properties.name: EDITOR_SCREEN_RESOLUTION
properties.description: The screen resolution of the Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13 Map Editor. Resolutions marked with * have an optimized screen layout.

properties.name: CUSTOM_SCREEN_RESOLUTION_X
properties.description: Applicable only when set to Custom Resolution (Game Screen Resolution / Editor Screen Resolution), minimum 800x600 in multiples of 2. Make sure monitor supports the custom resolution if playing in full screen mode

properties.name: CUSTOM_SCREEN_RESOLUTION_Y
properties.description: Applicable only when set to Custom Resolution (Game Screen Resolution / Editor Screen Resolution), minimum 800x600 in multiples of 2. Make sure monitor supports the custom resolution if playing in full screen mode

properties.name: SCREEN_MODE_WINDOWED
properties.description: Would you like to play the Jagged Alliance 2 v1.13 and the Map Editor in windowed mode?

properties.name: PLAY_INTRO
properties.description: Should the intro be played after starting a new game?
